name: composite bridges
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由不同材料或结构部件协同承载的桥梁。

complete_examples.text: The properties of the steel-concrete composite bridges of the Indian Railway for the span lengths of 19.4 m, 25.28 m and 31.9 m are being used to study the effect of higher harmonics of dominant frequencies on the dynamics of the railway bridges.

P093.title: Influence of dominant frequencies and their higher harmonics on the dynamic responses of railway bridge subjected to high-speed trains
